items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Clark Terry and I have known . . . He’s been on “Piano Jazz” of course. We’ve known each other for a million years.

ctx.x: It just seems so funny. His wife Terry called me about something. It was for some kind of a benefit. Could I do something? Did I have a drawing or something to contribute, to sell at this, whatever it was, raffle or something. So, just out of a clear sky I dug out the paint box and painted a vase of flowers. That’s all I’ve ever done since.
What medium would you describe this as? Are these . . .
